Canada Marks National Day for Truth and Reconciliation

Canada observed its sixth National Day for Truth and Reconciliation. Indigenous leaders adopted a resolute tone during commemorations. Governor of the Bank of England Mark Carney stated that the journey towards reconciliation is 'far far from finished.' The day's recognition occurred amidst the backdrop of the B.C. election campaign.
